note: The audit runs with A01 open at every part of its controls (families, time, presets, palettes, seed, parameters, library with an entry, export with a made image); the standalone settings and acknowledgements screens are now the one app's and are audited by SettingsUITests.testAuditOfSettingsAndAboutAtTheDefaultTextSize
Same walk at UICTContentSizeCategoryAccessibilityXXXL; settings and acknowledgements: SettingsUITests.testAuditOfSettingsAndAboutAtTheLargestTextSize
The description of session.canvas follows family, preset, palette and play state; the one app starts A01 in the Particles family
The time controls are A01's native controls below the canvas (the standalone app showed them in a sheet)

Gradient Noise is chosen first through the family control because the one app starts A01 in Particles; the parameter and reset identifiers are A01's parameter.warp and reset.warp instead of vc.param.warp
Export is A01's Make image control (2048 by 2048 square) and Share image; the standalone size and aspect pickers, dimension text and crop preview have no counterpart in the adapter and are not ported
The gallery is now A01's family control; a shader error ends the session in session.failure (the standalone gas.scene.error); the route title replaces the home title
The launch smoke test belongs to the one app: LaunchUITests.testAFirstLaunchShowsTheWelcome; A01's title on its route is checked by GASGalleryUITests.testGalleryListsFourFamiliesAndEachOpensACanvas

Save, survive the end of the app, rename, remove with confirmation (cancel keeps it) and open an entry; the adapter lists entries by name (not newest first) and has no favourites and no duplication (they stay in the standalone app until its retirement), so those steps are not ported
The one app has no -gasComposition import: corrupt data is a damaged stored state (-vcDamageState garbage); Reset of the notice is the counterpart of Use default
Future-version data is a stored state of a newer schema (-vcDamageState newer); the notice names the newer version and Reset continues

Counterpart: a readable stored state opens without a notice and with the composition it held; there are no correction notes in the one app and the clamping of out-of-range values is covered by the adapter's core unit tests
The settings screen belongs to the one app: SettingsUITests.testTheThreeSettingsSurviveARelaunch (Reduce Motion and Reduce Flashing persist across a relaunch)
The acknowledgements belong to the one app: SettingsUITests.testAboutShowsNameVersionAndAcknowledgements
